profile.name: Akula Chetan Krishna Sai
profile.introduction: I’m Chetan, a software engineer building cloud platforms, reliable backends, and useful interfaces.
profile.about: I enjoy working across the layers of a system: the interface people use, the services behind it, and the infrastructure that keeps it running.
profile.education: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering, VNR Vignana Jyothi Institute of Engineering and Technology, Hyderabad. Graduated in 2026 with a GPA of 8.12.
outside: Led my school football team to the U-15 CBSE Clusters semifinals.

experience.summary: Cloud observability, alerting, and the systems behind them.

highlights.title: TowerWatch monitoring
highlights.description: Developed resource overviews, historical graphs, and live updates across Go services and a React/Next.js portal for VMs, databases, storage, load balancers, managed Kubernetes, and Function Apps.
highlights.detail: Optimized retrieval with batched VictoriaMetrics queries, bounded caching, and incremental snapshots. Preserved unavailable states for missing telemetry and paused charts for scaled-to-zero functions.

highlights.title: Backend-owned alerting
highlights.description: Implemented organization-scoped alert rules, recipient validation, severity settings, and alert history. Connected Alertmanager webhooks to PostgreSQL-backed transitions and asynchronous email delivery.
highlights.detail: Used correlation-based notification deduplication to handle retries and concurrent requests.

highlights.title: Reliability across the stack
highlights.description: Extended Helm charts, recording rules, and exporters for worker readiness, pod capacity, and database metrics. Resolved PMM authentication, scrape discovery, and network policy issues.
highlights.detail: Added authenticated capacity checks to cloud lifecycle operations. Validated fixes through automated tests, live metric queries, and scoped Helm rollouts.

projects.title: SimManCee
projects.label: Business simulation platform
projects.description: An interactive business simulation experience, from reusable React interfaces to deployment on AWS.
details: Connected interactive simulation views to backend services through REST APIs, with responsive, reusable modules for simulations and team content.
Hosted the frontend on AWS S3 and the backend on EC2, with Route 53 handling custom-domain access.

projects.title: Post-HCT Survival Prediction
projects.label: Applied machine learning
projects.description: A five-model ensemble for survival prediction, evaluated with 10-fold cross-validation and demographic subgroup analysis.
details: Combined LightGBM, two XGBoost variants, HistGradientBoosting, and Random Forest, using Kaplan–Meier target transformation for censored outcomes.
Achieved a 0.6853 C-index and 0.1930 RMSE with 10-fold cross-validation. Analyzed feature importance and performance across six demographic groups.
Co-authored and presented the resulting research paper at ICIRCA 2026.

projects.title: Student Record Management
projects.label: Full-stack + DevOps
projects.description: Student record management backed by REST APIs, containerized delivery, and automated reliability checks.
details: Built a Node.js and MongoDB application with secure create, read, update, and delete operations for student records.

Containerized the application with Docker and implemented Jenkins pipelines to automate build and deployment. Added health checks and automated API tests to verify endpoint behavior and service availability.
